app.name: Timed Memories
app.summary: Shows a photo full-screen with a caption: how long ago it was taken relative to a reference date.
app.reference_date_hint: The date the age is calculated from, as year-month-day, e.g. 2025-06-15.
app.show_button_hint: A round button in the corner that triggers an action without waking the screen.
app.button_service_hint: The Home Assistant service to call when the button is tapped, e.g. image.reload.
